issueReference.title: Telescreen v1.2: editable notification templates, workflow notification target/channel sets, user roles and permission management, OIDC SSO (Keycloak), live verification of email and Slack delivery
issueReference.intakeCommunication: workflowInput (issue-resolution, no GitHub issue number); intake comm-000292

reviewContext.userProblem: Email (SMTP) and Slack delivery adapters exist behind the DLP-gated NotificationSender but were never verified against real services; notification text is hard-coded; workflow notify steps carry one channel and inline text; API authentication is coarse token scopes; OIDC SSO was deferred in v1. The owner asked to verify email via Mailpit and Slack via the tacogips-test workspace, make templates editable, let workflows declare destination plus method sets, add registered-user permission management, and integrate SSO tested against a Keycloak container with registered users.
requiredOutcomes: N1: versioned DB templates per name with one event kind, built-ins system.<event> as version 0 reproducing current text, path-only syntax, per-event allow-listed masked context, unknown variables rejected at save, list/get/create version/activate/validate/preview API with audit, Settings > Notification templates UI; rendering inside NotificationService.send before Redactor and the DLP gate.

N2: apiVersion telescreen.workflow/v2 named notification sets (recipients x channels x optional template), slack_channel: and email: recipients, notify steps, human task assignment and escalation tiers fan out one DLP-gated notification per target and channel with per-target rows (including skipped); validation rejects unknown sets, empty targets and undeliverable combinations; v1 documents load unchanged; workflow UI shows the sets.
N3: tests/live (marker live) for Mailpit, Slack and Keycloak skipped offline, and the telescreen notify test CLI through the real NotificationService and delivery handler.

R1: roles admin, responder, viewer; Permission enum per route action; one enforcement dependency on every router; route-walk test fails on any undeclared route; role assignment via API, UI and CLI, audited, last-admin protected; bound token permission = scope permissions intersected with role permissions plus machine permissions.

R2: UI Authorization Code + PKCE (hand-written, WebCrypto); backend JWT validation with discovery, JWKS caching and rotation, signature, iss, aud, exp/nbf leeway, rejecting none and HS*; (issuer, sub) keyed identity; verified-email linking or JIT creation (configurable); role and team claim mapping on each sign-in; 403 without a mapped role unless a default role; audited sign-ins; static-token login kept as configurable fallback; Keycloak setup documented.

Leak matrix extended (tests/leak/flows_v12.py, test_leak_matrix_v12.py) to templates, notification sets, role changes, token create/revoke, OIDC sign-ins and the notify-test path; E2E flows T1, T2, A1, A2.

mise run ci passes offline; src/web typecheck, vitest, build and the screenshot smoke (zero browser errors, new pages included) pass; README, examples/compose README (dev services), design docs and impl-plans index updated.

designDecisionsAndRationale: D1-D2: templates are names with immutable versions sharing one event kind, one active version per name; built-ins system.<event_kind> are version 0 in code and cannot be deleted, so referenced names always resolve.
D3-D4: existing path-only {{ path }} syntax; NotificationService.send renders when a request carries an event, call sites pass a typed NotificationContext, so there is one renderer and one DLP gate.
D5-D6: workflow-referenced templates must be workflow_notify; DSL v2 is explicit and v1 documents load unchanged.

D7-D8: add slack_channel:<id>, keep slack: and email:; every (target, channel) writes notification rows with set_name, target_index, template_name/version and event_kind; unreachable recipients on fan-out sites become skipped rows.
D9-D11: roles admin/responder/viewer mirror v1 scopes read/write/admin; ingest.push is machine-only from scopes; bound token = (scope & role) | (scope & machine); OIDC session = role permissions.

D12: 0003_v1_2 sets each member's role from the highest scope among its non-revoked bound tokens, so no existing token gains or loses access; v12-p06 seeds roles in the four bound-token test fixtures for the same reason.

D13-D16: realm_access.roles default role claim with telescreen-* map, groups map to teams only; IdP is authoritative for SSO users' roles on each sign-in; link provisioning by default, create optional; (issuer, sub) stored only as a keyed member_identities row.

D17-D20: no server-side session (tokens in sessionStorage, no CSRF surface); static tokens always accepted and TELESCREEN_UI_TOKEN_LOGIN controls only the login page; pyjwt[crypto] via typed entry points; notify test CLI exercises the production path.

Wave DAG: vocabulary/ports, DB and UI foundation first; services, enforcement, identity and UI pages in parallel; routers (wave 3) separated from wiring (wave 4) because wiring builds every router; leak matrix, E2E, live tests, docs and final gates last (wave 5).
intentionalTradeoffs: v12-p06 owns four bound-token fixture files (tests/evidence/test_evidence.py, tests/api/v11_issues/test_issues_router.py, tests/api/v11_ops/test_api_ops.py, tests/leak/flows_v11.py) and tests/workflow/engine/test_engine_extended.py for role seeding and Principal construction only; git diff must show no assertion or scope change.

v12-p04 tests/e2e tests/leak run and v12-p07 tests/api/common run are informational during fanout and are Progress Log evidence, not manifest verification entries.
The screenshot smoke is a gate in v12-p03 and v12-p12; a missing browser is a recorded verification gap, never a pass.
No jti replay store; short-lived IdP access tokens and exp/nbf leeway at most 300 s are accepted.
supportedEdgeCases: v1 workflow documents and inline notify text keep working; v2-only fields in a v1 document are a validation error.

Unknown template name, unknown variable, workflow template with a non-workflow_notify event, unknown set, empty targets and undeliverable channel/recipient combinations are rejected with path-only errors.
Unreachable or unknown recipients on fan-out sites produce skipped rows; a row with no address on its channel becomes failed.
Bound token with role None still gets ingest.push when scopes carry ingest or admin; unbound tokens keep exact v1 scope behavior.
Removing or demoting the last admin through API, UI or CLI is rejected (last_admin); IdP-driven demotion is applied and audited; CLI member set-role recovers.

OIDC: alg none/HS*, jku/x5u/jwk headers, wrong iss/aud/azp/typ, expired or not-yet-valid tokens, JWKS key rotation, IdP unavailable, no mapped role (403 no_role), unverified email, identity conflict, link vs create provisioning.
Keycloak realm users alice (admin), bob (responder), carol (viewer), dave (no role, 403) map as designed.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live Mailpit, Slack and Keycloak behavior beyond tests/live, which the owner runs after this run; real docker compose up during fanout.
Live PostgreSQL/Meilisearch behavior beyond marked integration tests skipped offline.
Slack read-back requiring scopes beyond chat.postMessage (conversations.history only if the token already has the scope).
Multiple concurrent OIDC issuers and IdP-side session management beyond RP-initiated logout.
